title: Asset Bible
description: Canonical visual-identity contract for recurring locations/subjects. Each asset has a stable id (the foreign-key target for VisualSpec.asset_ref), locked identity attributes, and a canonical reference image used to anchor every AI-generated shot of that asset so it stays visually consistent across the documentary.

asset_id.description: Stable foreign-key id referenced by VisualSpec.asset_ref (e.g. loc_kennestone_marietta, subj_seg_001)

description.description: Canonical prose description of the asset's appearance

locked_attributes.description: Immutable identity tokens injected into every shot's prompt (period, materials, palette, signature details)

period_constraints.description: Hard historical constraints, e.g. '1985 era — no anachronisms'

negative_attributes.description: Things that must NOT appear (modern fixtures, digital signage, etc.)

canonical_reference_image.description: Path to the single canonical reference image (image-to-video anchor). Empty until generated.

canonical_image_url.description: Public URL of the canonical image from the provider (Kie). Used as the host-free i2v anchor so no third-party upload is needed.

canonical_image_prompt.description: Prompt used to produce the canonical reference image (reproducibility)

appears_in.description: Segment IDs that reference this asset

continuity_group.description: Optional group of assets that may legitimately resemble each other (exempted together from dedup)

uniqueness_exempt.description: Shots of this asset are intended to look alike — exempt from the perceptual-duplicate check
